name: Mzansi Tyres
description: South Africa's leading manufacturer of high-performance tyres.
story: Mzansi Tyres is a proudly South African company dedicated to providing quality tyres for all types of vehicles. With a passion for motorsport, we believe in supporting local talent and pushing the boundaries of performance. We seek a partnership that showcases our tyres' durability and performance on the track, enhancing brand recognition nationwide.
